ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: <image>If $\overline{PR} \| \overline{WX}, WX=10, XY=6, WY=8, RY=5,$ and $PS=3,$ find $PQ$.
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached diagram, Y, S, W are on the same upper horizontal line, and R, Q are on the lower horizontal line; Y, X are a vertical segment, and P, S, Q are also on the same vertical line. Points R, Y, P are on the same upper slanted line, points X, W are on the lower slanted line, and the problem gives PR ∥ WX. The diagram also marks a right angle, showing that △WXY is a right triangle formed by the horizontal side WY, the vertical side XY, and the hypotenuse WX. Reasoning: It is known that WX=10, XY=6, WY=8, so △WXY is a 6-8-10 right triangle. Because PR ∥ WX, and RY is on PR, RY has the same direction as WX. RY=5, which is half of WX=10, so its vertical component is also half of XY=6, namely 3. This means the vertical height difference from Y to R is 3. Since S and Y are on the same horizontal line, and Q and R are on the same horizontal line, SQ=3. Also PS=3, therefore PQ=PS+SQ=3+3=6.

method.method_draft: Use a synthetic similarity/component route. From the image, note that WXY is a right triangle with XY vertical, YW horizontal, and WX slanted; R, Y, P are collinear on the upper slanted line, and P, S, Q are vertical with S on the upper horizontal YW and Q on the lower horizontal through R. From the text, use WX=10, XY=6, WY=8, RY=5, PS=3, and PR ∥ WX. Since PR is parallel to WX, segment RY has the same direction ratio as WX. Triangle WXY is a 6-8-10 right triangle, so a segment parallel to WX of length 5 has vertical component 5*(6/10)=3. Thus the vertical separation between R and Y, equivalently between the lower horizontal through Q and the upper horizontal through S, is SQ=3. Then PQ=PS+SQ=3+3=6.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic coordinate route. From the image, set Y=(0,0), put W=(8,0) on the upper horizontal, and X=(0,-6) on the vertical below Y, so WX has direction vector (8,6) from X to W and slope 3/4. From the text, PR ∥ WX and RY=5; since R is left and below Y on line PR, the vector from R to Y is half of (8,6), namely (4,3), so R=(-4,-3). The lower horizontal through R contains Q, so Q has y-coordinate -3. Also S lies on the upper horizontal, P is vertically above S, and PS=3, so P has y-coordinate 3. Because P lies on the line through R parallel to WX, solve y+3=(3/4)(x+4); at y=3 this gives x=4, hence P=(4,3), S=(4,0), and Q=(4,-3). Therefore PQ=3-(-3)=6.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中，点Y、S、W在同一条上方水平线上，点R、Q在一条较低的水平线上；从Y向下有竖直线段到X，从P向下经过S到Q也是竖直线。线段PR是上方斜线，经过R、Y并到达P；线段WX是下方斜线，经过X、Q并到达W。图中有直角标记，表示这些竖直线与水平线垂直。题目给出PR ∥ WX。

推理：按解析几何法设Y=(0,0)。因为WY=8且Y、W在同一水平线上，取W=(8,0)；因为XY=6且X在Y正下方，取X=(0,-6)。于是从X到W的方向向量为(8,6)，斜率为6/8=3/4，且WX=10符合6-8-10直角三角形。
由于PR ∥ WX，所以PR的斜率也是3/4。又RY=5，而与斜率3/4对应的5单位方向向量是(4,3)。图中R在Y的左下方，所以从R到Y的向量为(4,3)，因此R=(-4,-3)。下方水平线经过R和Q，所以Q的y坐标是-3。
图中S在上方水平线，故S的y坐标为0；PS=3且P在S正上方，所以P的y坐标为3。P在经过R且平行于WX的直线上，该直线方程为y+3=(3/4)(x+4)。令y=3，得6=(3/4)(x+4)，所以x+4=8，x=4。因此P=(4,3)，S=(4,0)，Q=(4,-3)。
所以PQ是竖直距离：PQ=3-(-3)=6。
